lessons.title: Read and validate a small record
lessons.objective: Separate text, Python values and an application contract.
lessons.explanation: A JSON parser answers whether text has valid syntax. Your application still needs to decide whether the values are useful. Missing information should stay missing instead of acquiring a guessed default.
lessons.example:
import json
record = json.loads('{"task": "Review draft", "owner": null}')
assert isinstance(record["task"], str)
assert record["owner"] is None
lessons.exercise: Parse three records: a valid task, malformed JSON and a task with no owner. Give each failure a distinct explanation.
lessons.completion_check: You can distinguish a JSON syntax error from an invalid application record and preserve an unknown owner.
lessons.artifact: Three small records and a parser test.

lessons.title: Make a failure reproducible
lessons.objective: Express a successful behavior and its failure boundary as tests.
lessons.explanation: Write the expected result before modifying the implementation. A test with a single example only supports that example; add cases that exercise a different failure mechanism.
lessons.exercise: Write an assertion for a valid record and one for malformed input. Introduce a bug deliberately and check that a test catches it.
lessons.completion_check: Both tests pass for the correct code, and the intentionally broken version fails the relevant test.

lessons.title: Separate an API from its caller
lessons.objective: Make an integration testable without network access.
lessons.explanation: Pass the transport into your application function. The application consumes a response contract; a real adapter later handles credentials, timeouts and provider-specific fields. The fake verifies wiring, not model quality.
lessons.exercise: Replace the fake with one that raises TimeoutError. Decide what the caller should display and ensure no partial result is accepted.
lessons.completion_check: The same application interface handles a success and a timeout using injected transports.
lessons.artifact: An adapter boundary with a timeout test.
